message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | # | What to Do | How It Works | |---|------------|--------------| | 1 | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. | | 2 | **Turn Order** | • Players take turns clockwise (or counter‑clockwise if a “Reverse” card is played). | | 3 | **Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches the **color** or **number** (or symbol) of the top discard.
• If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. | | 4 | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the next color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn (must be played only if you have no other playable card). | | 5 | **Winning a Turn** | • If you play your last card, shout “UNO!” when you have **one** card left. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two cards as a penalty. | | 6 | **Winning the Game** | • The first player to reach **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed score) wins. Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | 7 | **House Rules (Optional)** | • **Stacking** – Players can stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards to avoid drawing.
• **No “Wild Draw Four” if you could play a color** – Some groups enforce this stricter rule.
• **Custom scoring** – e.g., 300 points, or first to 3 rounds. | **Quick Tips** - Keep an eye on what colors your opponents are avoiding; that’s a hint they’re low on that color. - Use Wild cards strategically to change the color when you’re stuck. - Remember to shout “UNO!” when you’re down to one card—failure to do so can cost you two cards. Enjoy your game!
